productOnPage.title: Baking with Yoto UK
productOnPage.author: Yoto
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Grab your apron - it’s time to get baking! These five easy-to-follow audio recipes are scrumptiously delicious and perfect for budding bakers. Narrated by Strictly star and Great British Bake Off winner John Whaite. Grab your apron - it’s time to get baking! Baking with Yoto is perfect for budding bakers; featuring five simple recipe Cards that kids can follow at their own pace. From prepping ingredients to cooking; eating; and even tidying up; this scrumptious activity pack gives kids the opportunity to take the lead in the kitchen - with a mega side-serving of fun! A great family activity for a rainy afternoon; or prepping for a picnic or party.Please note: the activities in this pack require adult supervision and use of kitchen appliances. Tracks included: Hello and Welcome to Baking with Yoto! Are You Ready To Grab Your Ingredients? Self-Raising Flour Baking Powder Two Bananas Two Eggs Milk You've Gathered All Your Ingredients! Are You Ready To Grab Your Equipment? Two Big Bowls One Teaspoon and One Fork Kitchen Scales A Measuring Jug A Frying Pan Spoon, Ladle, Spatula A Plate A Hob You've Gathered All Of Your Equipment! Measure the Flour Measure the Baking Powder Mix! Put The Bowl Aside Peel the Bananas Mash the Bananas Crack the Eggs Whisk! Measure the Milk Whisk Again! Add Everything Together Mix It Up! You've Made Banana Pancake Batter! Turn on Your Hob Pour Your Pancake Watch Carefully... Bubble Bubble! Time to Flip! Cook the Other Side Let's Cook Another One! Watch Out For Those Bubbles! Flip! Cooking Music Tidy Up Time Time to Tuck In!

yotoCreatorModal.body:
#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
